run_train_lm: run the LM training loop with a YAML config file via python train.py config=path/to/config.yaml
run_train_with_cli_overrides: run training with CLI overrides like python train.py config=cfg.yaml model.dim=512 steps=5000
run_async_eval_on_slurm: run async evaluation on a Slurm cluster by setting async_eval_gpus=8 in the training config
review_TrainArgs: review the TrainArgs dataclass to understand all configurable training hyperparameters and nested args
review_TrainState: review the TrainState class to understand how training state is saved and restored via state_dict
